description: Decode a Base64 image or data URI (data:image/png;base64,..., raw Base64, URL-safe or unpadded Base64, a CSS url(...) value, or a URL-encoded SVG data URI) and report its real format sniffed from the magic bytes, pixel size, decoded byte size, a normalized data URI length, and warnings such as a declared MIME type that does not match the bytes or an image too big to inline. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO, SVG, AVIF, HEIC and TIFF.

data.description: A data URI or a Base64 string

name: decode_base64_image
